mainText: Hello, Verona! At 3 PM, we are looking at 62 degrees with overcast skies at Verona Community Park. The ISS will pass overhead tonight, but it will be hidden from view by the clouds.

The city announced that road maintenance for crack filling is scheduled to begin on Monday, September 28, affecting areas like South Nine Mound Road and North Jefferson Street. Additionally, the Plan Commission will meet on October 5 to discuss various development projects, including a site plan for Sub-Zero in the Liberty Business Park.

You have plenty to do this week, starting with Yoga at Insight Wellness today. Tomorrow, you can test your knowledge at Hop Haus trivia, Quizmasters trivia at Lake Lou-ee, or Dream Day trivia at Paddy Mac's. Looking ahead, don't miss the Verona Fall Fest this Friday, September 25.

On September 5, local officers responded to reports of a viral social media prank known as the Dairy Dare, where unidentified individuals placed cheese slices on windshields throughout the city. No property damage was reported.
Culver's of Verona is currently open until 10 PM today, though please be aware that the store is undergoing a remodel.
